mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 73 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School, and with an air quality index of 52, it is a moderate day to be outside. If you were looking to the stars, the International Space Station passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

City Hall is now open for in-person absentee voting during the two weeks leading up to the election, and the city is also observing the Week Without Driving through October 8 to better understand the barriers faced by non-drivers in our community.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee happening today, followed by the downtown farmer's market, yoga, and trivia at the Bogey Factory taking place tomorrow.
On September 21, a retail theft incident occurred involving the theft of Swedish Fish candy from a retailer on East Verona Avenue, and the offender was later identified and cited.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and since the restaurant is open until 10:00 PM, there is still time to head over and enjoy a treat before they close for the evening.
